name: 3d-skill
description: Plan, build, preview and iterate production 3D for the web and Blender: references to spec to brief to build, with versioned previews.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, preview and iterate web 3D and Blender
interface.longDescription: Turn a prompt, a photo or a video into 3D: a measured spec, brief and shot list, then an interactive three.js/R3F model or scene, a Blender asset or render, or a web-ready GLB, with versioned previews you review and iterate on.
defaultPrompt: Use $3d to rebuild the product in this photo as a 3D model visitors can spin on our product page.
Use $3d to optimize this GLB for the web and report the budget.
Use $3d to build a Blender product turntable and export a web-ready GLB.
